item.title: WCBB: No. 7 LSU rallies to beat No. 17 Ole Miss 78-70
item.description: OXFORD, Miss. (AP) — MiLaysia Fulwiley scored 26 points as No.7 LSU erased an 11-point deficit in the final eight minutes and beat No. 17 Ole Miss 78-70 on Thursday night.
